## Release scope

- [ ] Linked accountable issue:
- [ ] This change is allowed during the temporary feature freeze: bug fix,
      testability, documentation, or accessibility.
- [ ] If this is a balance change, the linked issue contains deterministic
      before/after evidence.
- [ ] This does not add a new mechanic, target, event chain, audiovisual set
      piece, or unrelated feature work.

## Verification

- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant deterministic regression checks pass.
- [ ] Save compatibility was checked or is not affected.
- [ ] Completion evidence is attached to the issue before it moves to Done.
